newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Radio Centro rated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Radio Centro rated as buy.

text.p: Lazard Freres said Wednesday it had initiated coverage of Mexican broadcaster Grupo Radio Centro with a buy rating.

Analyst Alfredo Jollon said the company should participate strongly in the recovery of the Mexican advertising market as former clients return and as first-time customers such as pension funds and long-distance carriers enter the market.
"We initiate coverage of Radio Centro with a buy rating and a 12-month price target of $21," Jollon said.
He added that Lazard Freres had estimated the company would post 1997 earnings per share of $0.75, rising to $1.00 in 1998.
